instructions: Review the available clinical information independently.
The primary question is whether additional renal review is warranted; this is not a CKD diagnosis.
Additional renal review may include chart review, repeat/additional renal testing, or nephrology referral.
Not measured means unavailable in the original observation window and must not be interpreted as normal.
Relative timing is shown without direct dates; measurements displayed together may come from different encounters.
Record information sufficiency separately from the binary renal-review recommendation.
Do not discuss cases with final study reviewers before their ratings are locked.
